name: Masjed-e Jāmé of Isfahan
description: The Friday Mosque stands in the historic heart of Isfahan, Iran, and has been built up, rebuilt and added to since the 9th century. Its sprawling complex of more than 20,000 square metres wraps around a four-sided courtyard, a layout borrowed from pre-Islamic Persian palaces. Look up to see its ribbed double-shelled domes, and around you the tilework and decoration of a thousand years of Islamic art.
